articles.title: Woman ignored months of weakness, doctor says body shut down reproductive system to keep her alive
articles.description: A woman presented with a dangerously low hemoglobin of 1.9 g/dL after three years of severe weakness, her body shutting down reproductive functions to prioritize vital organs. Despite prior warnings and a significantly lower hemoglobin level a year ago, she delayed seeking medical help due to family obligations, highlighting a critical need to address women's health and chronic exhaustion.
